mail-1.subject: Fwd: Nadia Fischer sent you a message on LinkedIn
mail-1.body:
Moving this off the work account.

Nadia Fischer · Technical Recruiter at Meridian Labs

"Hi Bob — your CI work on Northstar's Atlas release came up twice in our team this week. We are hiring for a build-reliability role and I would love twenty minutes of your time."

Her profile and the thread are on LinkedIn: http://linkedin.com/

mail-2.subject: Meridian Labs — happy to talk
mail-2.body:
Hi Nadia — thanks for reaching out. Twenty minutes is fine, but not this week: we are shipping something and I am on the CI section of the checklist.

Next Tuesday afternoon, my time? Please use this address rather than my work one.

mail-3.subject: That monitor
mail-3.body:
You asked which one I got — this is it, and it is worth the money: http://amazon.com/dp/b0monitor27

$429.99, single cable to the laptop, no dock.
